criterion: Error messages: actionable for the CLI caller
description: CLI validation errors say "Supply an email" / "Supply a name" without naming the flag (--email / --name) the caller omitted, while other CLI errors do name flags ("Supply --kind device|agent|member and --id").
suggested_fix: Validate required flags in client-cli before calling the service, and name the flag.

description: An agent that tries to correct the identity with a new operation ID gets IDENTITY_EXISTS "Identity already initialized; linking requires My device", which neither states the current identity nor that identities can't be changed. An agent will likely loop or misinterpret it as a device-linking requirement.
expected: "An identity already exists on this client (Aisha Rahman, aisha@quillstack.io). It can't be changed here." with details carrying the current identity.
suggested_fix: Include the current identity in error.details and reword the message (see F-014-03).
